name: finds shortest distances on an open board
test:
assert min_knight_moves(6, 7, (0, 0), (1, 2), set()) == 1
assert min_knight_moves(8, 8, (0, 0), (4, 5), set()) == 3
assert min_knight_moves(8, 8, (0, 0), (0, 0), set()) == 0

name: respects blocked cells and can take a detour
input: a blocked square near an otherwise reachable destination
test:
assert min_knight_moves(5, 5, (0, 0), (2, 2), {(1, 2)}) == 4
assert min_knight_moves(5, 5, (0, 0), (2, 2), {(2, 2)}) is None
assert min_knight_moves(5, 5, (0, 0), (2, 2), {(0, 0)}) is None

name: returns none when the finite board has no legal route
input: two distinct cells on a two by two board
